texts.label: text
texts.orig: 1.1 The TSV7H series are 32-bit microcontrollers built around an RV32IMFC core with a single-precision floating-point unit, a 16 KB instruction cache and a 16 KB data cache. They embed up to 1024 KB of dual-bank flash memory with error-correcting code (ECC), 512 KB of SRAM, and an internal low-dropout regulator (LDO) whose output, VCORE, is set by one of four voltage-scaling ranges, VOS0 to VOS3.
texts.text: 1.1 The TSV7H series are 32-bit microcontrollers built around an RV32IMFC core with a single-precision floating-point unit, a 16 KB instruction cache and a 16 KB data cache. They embed up to 1024 KB of dual-bank flash memory with error-correcting code (ECC), 512 KB of SRAM, and an internal low-dropout regulator (LDO) whose output, VCORE, is set by one of four voltage-scaling ranges, VOS0 to VOS3.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 1.2 The peripherals include two 12-bit successive-approximation ADCs (ADC1 and ADC2) of up to 3.57 Msps, a 12-bit DAC, two CAN FD controllers (FDCAN1 and FDCAN2), four USARTs, three SPI interfaces with I2S and TI frame modes, two I2C interfaces with SMBus and PMBus support, a CORDIC co-processor for trigonometric functions, and an advanced-control timer (TIM1) with complementary PWM outputs, dead-time insertion and break inputs.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 5.2 Three phase-locked loops, PLL1, PLL2 and PLL3, take their reference from HSI, CSI or HSE through a pre-divider DIVMx of 1 to 63. Each PLL has a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) and three output dividers, P, Q and R, each of 1 to 128. SYSCLK is taken from the P output of PLL1, from HSI, from CSI or from HSE. The P divider of PLL1 accepts only even values; the P dividers of PLL2 and PLL3 accept any value.
